test_single_job_registry: test the JobsRegistry by scheduling a single StopesModule and verifying it completes successfully
test_array_jobs_registry: test the JobsRegistry by scheduling an array of StopesModules and verifying all complete
schedule_module_and_check_registry: schedule a StopesModule via Launcher and assert all jobs reach COMPLETED status in the registry
review_Launcher_schedule: review the Launcher class schedule method that accepts a StopesModule and returns an awaitable job
review_JobsRegistry_get_job: review the JobsRegistry get_job method that retrieves a job by id and returns its status
